cancellation.reason: The worker hit a repeated cgroup OOM during the first p53/15ns run, so the remaining sweep points were canceled instead of repeating the same clock-independent TECHMAP blow-up.

conclusion: R5 proved that explicit hierarchy preservation was real and sufficient to stop premature flattening, but it did not remove the underlying wide generic-divider arithmetic cost. The next retry should replace those merge nodes with the folded Mersenne exact implementation rather than revisiting the same hierarchy-only point.
